title: Delivery and display
acceptance: All-day at the brief's time; range at its start; until ahead of the end; Coming up, inbox and brief show the kind
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
validation: Regression or fixture for each acceptance item; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 1.5 hours agent; former 1-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 1 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 1.5 h → 1 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Implemented 2026-11-12 (all-day delivery at brief.at and rescheduling in src/store.ts and src/executors.ts, Coming up in web/public/dashboard/live.js, workspace in web/src/main.ts and web/src/i18n.ts, inbox in src/store.ts, and Hyuga's brief in src/brief.ts; test/core.test.ts, test/brief.test.ts, test/dashboard.test.ts, test/angular.browser.mjs) in about 0.25 h agent (stated). Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (0.25 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
